en: Black‑and‑white view down a cobblestone street lined with 2–3 story plastered townhouses with steep tiled roofs and dormers, typical of Central European small towns. A few pedestrians walk along the sidewalks, and in the distance two slender church towers rise above the rooftops. The scene feels calm and residential, with no visible motor traffic and no printed caption or border on the image itself.
